hero.title: About Nashray
hero.subtitle: Interiors photographed with precision, restraint, and editorial intent.

story.title: Spaces, translated.
paragraphs: Nashray is a Dubai-based interior and architectural photography studio specializing in clarity, restraint, and timeless composition.
Every project begins with understanding the designer's intent—the way light moves, how materials interact, what the space wants to say.
From residential interiors to hospitality spaces, the approach remains consistent: capture what matters, remove what doesn't.

steps.title: Planning
steps.description: We study the space before shooting—light angles, sightlines, designer intent.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Precision in composition, natural light prioritized, minimal intervention.

steps.title: Refinement
steps.description: Post-production focused on clarity—enhancing what's there, removing distraction.

philosophy.summary: From penthouses to boutique hotels, the process balances natural light with architectural detail—creating images that feel both editorial and authentic.
